input.quote: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
input.rationale: The cap in 21.1 is mutual, but its basis is only one month of Fees "actually paid" — far below the fallback of 12 months' fees and below even the walk-away threshold of six months' fees. "Fees" (Section 1.5) also excludes the one-time implementation charge, further shrinking the base. Worse, "without exception" pulls the Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) defined in 21.3 inside the cap, contradicting 21.2 and leaving indemnities capped with no super-cap — expressly walk-away territory. Sections 21.2, 21.3 and 21.4 are otherwise consistent with our preferred position (mutual consequential-damages exclusion, direct-damage list, full carve-out set, payment obligations not "damages"), so the minimal fix is to correct the cap basis in 21.1 and restore the Excluded Claims carve-out.

proposal.summary: Replace one-month "without exception" cap with mutual greater-of 12 months' Fees / USD 1,000,000 cap, with Excluded Claims uncapped
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have raised the cap to the greater of twelve months' Fees and USD 1,000,000 for both Parties, which is our standard position; a one-month fee cap is not a meaningful remedy for the committed spend here. We also removed "without exception" so that the Excluded Claims in Section 21.3 (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) sit outside the cap as Section 21.2 already contemplates.

ops.oldText: Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: Except for Excluded Claims, which are not subject to any limitation of liability under this Section, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
